response.speaker: Flins
response.text: There is indeed quite a lot. After accounting for daily necessities and emergency supplies, there's still enough to set aside in case of sudden visits from my colleagues.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: After all, my personal requirements are modest. It would be a waste not to save the excess and use it to help others in need.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you get?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Lamp oil, candles, leather, paper, and pens. Oh, and a few bottles of strong liquor and some emergency food, of course.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Haha! Judging by your expression, I can tell you're wondering, "what emergency food did you buy, exactly."

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: These supplies need to stand the test of time, so all of this food has undergone "special" processing. I assure you, unless you're on the brink of starvation, you don't want to try it.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: The cured meat, for example, is as tough as tree bark, and the biscuits taste like tossed-out newspaper.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Even if you soaked them in milk or vegetable soup, the best you could hope for is soggy newspaper.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It sounds like you're speaking from experience...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Well... there are times when one has no other choice. I've tried to extract nutrients from this "food" before.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm impressed you managed to eat it...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Ah... Well... "Eat" might not be the best word to use... I have a somewhat more efficient method.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Here, I'll show you.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I suppose you could call it "cooking with fire," hahaha.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: There have been a few more... desperate moments, when I've been trapped alongside other poor souls.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: You should know, if I were to use the method I've just shown you in front of my colleagues, it might leave them feeling uneasy.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: And so... I have at such times been forced to... attempt to swallow this food, as they would.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Though try as I might, I really was unable to swallow it. In the end, I broke it down into smaller pieces — some of which I stuffed into my mouth, and some of which I dropped into my lantern when no one was looking...

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Unfortunately, my colleagues noticed how slowly I was eating and mistook my reluctance for concern, believing I was eating less to allow them more.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: After that, they patted me on the back and enthusiastically filled my arms with more cured meat and biscuits...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Colleagues can be like that.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Indeed. I was grateful for their noble act of kindness and can clearly remember the taste of cured meat and biscuits to this day.

choices.text: Wait a moment... How do you know what it tastes like, then?
It looks like quite a lot...
